quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) results: net sales JPY 1,128,610 million, up 44.7% (JPY 348,903 million); operating income JPY 499,120 million, up 118.8%, with the operating margin up 14.9 points to 44.2% (29.3% a year earlier); profit before tax JPY 516,720 million, up 129.9%; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 375,353 million, up 132.9%. The cost-of-sales ratio fell 7.2 points to 35.7% on a better product mix. Management states that AI-related tester demand for high-performance semiconductors expanded sharply and that the company expanded its product supply capacity to meet customers' strong capital spending and delivered on time. Average exchange rates: USD 150 (153 a year earlier), EUR 173 (164).
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 1,128,610 million (+44.7%); operating income JPY 499,120 million (+118.8%), margin 44.2%; net income JPY 375,353 million (+132.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management states the tester market grew for a second consecutive year in calendar 2025 and Advantest gained share: its semiconductor tester market share was 58% in calendar 2024 and 65% in calendar 2025, which it attributes to selling products that anticipated shifts in test demand and to its priority customer and region strategies. It attributes the FY2026 sales growth to meeting the demand growth of its main customers, steadily capturing demand from new customers, and the strategic production-capacity expansion it had pursued in anticipation of high demand.

Test System segment (SoC test systems, memory test systems, test handlers, device interfaces and system-level test; 90.3% of FY2026 sales): sales JPY 1,019,390 million, up 49.3%; segment profit JPY 518,760 million, up 97.9%. In SoC test systems, sales for high-performance SoC semiconductors rose sharply as growing chip complexity and performance, driven mainly by demand for HPC devices and AI-related semiconductors, pushed up tester demand, while tester demand for mature semiconductors for automotive and industrial equipment was soft. Stronger product supply capacity also contributed to the segment's growth. Production is handled by the company and several outside contract manufacturers.
quarterly_data.figure: Test System sales JPY 1,019,390 million (+49.3%); segment profit JPY 518,760 million (+97.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Services and Others segment (9.7% of FY2026 sales): sales JPY 109,230 million, up 12.7%; segment profit JPY 8,758 million against a JPY 16,125 million loss a year earlier (which included JPY 21,393 million of goodwill and intangible-asset impairment); this year's profit includes a JPY 2,504 million gain on the transfer of part of a business. Support-service sales grew with the larger installed base of the group's products, and sales of consumables such as test interface boards, mainly for high-performance SoC semiconductors, also increased.
quarterly_data.figure: Services and Others sales JPY 109,230 million (+12.7%); segment profit JPY 8,758 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 sales by region: overseas sales ratio 97.8% (98.0% a year earlier). Asia excluding Japan JPY 1,035,850 million, up 48.7%, mainly on strong sales of SoC semiconductor test equipment in Taiwan; Japan JPY 25,137 million, up 58.6%; Americas JPY 44,474 million, down 5.6%; Europe JPY 23,149 million, up 16.0%.
quarterly_data.figure: Asia ex-Japan JPY 1,035,850 million (+48.7%); overseas ratio 97.8%

quarterly_data.signal: Third medium-term management plan (MTP3, company fiscal years 2024-2026, i.e. the years to March 2025 through March 2027) targets, revised upward in October 2025 because AI/HPC semiconductor test demand was expected to be stronger than assumed and internal measures such as market-share gains had progressed: three-year average net sales 8,350-9,300 (100 million yen), operating margin 33-36%, net income 2,070-2,480 (100 million yen), ROIC 34-39%, basic EPS JPY 284-341 (assuming USD 1 = JPY 140, EUR 1 = JPY 155). Fiscal 2025 (year to March 2026) actuals: net sales 11,286 (100 million yen), operating margin 44.2%, net income 3,754 (100 million yen), ROIC 54.4%, EPS JPY 515.15. Management states progress on the MTP3 strategic measures, led by the 'Automation of Test' offering and building an industry ecosystem for it, is ahead of expectations overall; fiscal 2026 (year to March 2027) is the plan's final year.
quarterly_data.figure: MTP3 3-year average targets: net sales 8,350-9,300 (100 million yen), operating margin 33-36%, ROIC 34-39%, EPS JPY 284-341

quarterly_data.signal: Management's view of the fiscal 2026 environment: AI-related semiconductors will keep leading growth of the calendar 2026 semiconductor market, which some forecasts put at more than about US$1 trillion, and the company expects the semiconductor tester market to reach its largest size ever on higher production volumes and further complexity of AI-related semiconductors. It cautions that tension in the Middle East raises concern over a global slowdown, and that with demand staying high, supply shortages could arise across the whole supply chain and affect customers' products and its own; it will keep focusing on strengthening supply-chain resilience.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor tester market expected at its largest size ever in 2026; no specific figure

quarterly_data.signal: Listed as fiscal 2025 (year to March 2026) progress under MTP3: Advantest received its first order for silicon photonics test for large-scale mass-production use, and preparations progressed to launch high-value test solutions for next-generation DRAM and silicon photonics. Its R&D in the year included optical semiconductor devices, light sources and photonic integrated circuits for photonic-electronic convergence device test systems, and the alignment and interface transmission technologies such device test needs.
quarterly_data.figure: First silicon photonics order for large-scale mass production; no specific figure

quarterly_data.signal: Also listed as fiscal 2025 (year to March 2026) progress under MTP3: several next-generation test solutions launched; growing industry recognition of SiConic, its solution that automates silicon validation by linking electronic design automation (EDA) tools with its ATE; the opening of the Advantest Innovation Center and joining Applied Materials' EPIC (Equipment and Process Innovation and Commercialization) platform; deeper strategic partnerships with three probe card makers toward high-performance total test solutions; and supply-chain management with close supplier collaboration that let it keep up with the steep rise in product demand.

FY2026 R&D expenses were 781 (100 million yen), against 714 a year earlier; R&D staff are about 30% of group employees, with R&D sites in Japan, Europe, the US and China. Themes in the year included: test systems that test ultra-high-speed memory at actual operating speed; more functional, space-saving DRAM and flash test systems; high-speed memory and SoC burn-in systems; space-saving SoC test systems for highly parallel test of high-pin-count devices; high-voltage, high-current testers for power devices used in EVs; high-throughput memory test handlers; SoC test handlers for large-package, high-heat devices; equipment that handles the silicon dies of chiplet devices; real-time hot/cold temperature control; electron-beam metrology for leading-edge photomasks; system-level test for semiconductors and modules; test sockets and thermal control units; and test-program generation and debugging using AI, LLMs and agents.

FY2026 capital expenditure (property, plant and equipment and intangible assets) totaled 343 (100 million yen), centered on new-product development, production rationalization and labour saving, and production capacity expansion: Test System segment 262 and Services and Others 65 (100 million yen). The report states no notable plans for new facilities or retirements.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex 343 (100 million yen): Test System 262, Services and Others 65
